content.text:
You have a few good options, depending on how fast you need it and whether you want a custom/local cake:

### Best options in the U.S.

- **Goldbelly** — good for famous bakery cakes shipped nationwide, like Milk Bar, Carlo’s Bakery, etc. Best if you can order a few days ahead. ([goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/best-birthday-cakes?utm_source=openai))  
- **Bake Me A Wish!** — specializes in birthday cakes and bakery gifts shipped nationwide. ([bakemeawish.com](https://www.bakemeawish.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Instacart** — good for same-day delivery from grocery-store bakeries near the recipient, such as Costco, Safeway, Publix, Kroger, Wegmans, Whole Foods, etc., depending on location. ([instacart.com](https://www.instacart.com/cake-delivery?msockid=0a91e198ca3d61653a14f744cb876021&utm_source=openai))  
- **Carlo’s Bakery** — offers birthday cakes and other baked goods with nationwide delivery/local pickup options. ([shop.carlosbakery.com](https://shop.carlosbakery.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **SusieCakes** — good if there’s a location near the recipient; they also ship some best-selling cakes nationwide. ([susiecakes.com](https://susiecakes.com/?utm_source=openai))  

### My quick recommendation
- **Need it today/tomorrow?** Use **Instacart**, DoorDash, Uber Eats, or a local bakery’s website.  
- **Want something special shipped?** Use **Goldbelly** or **Bake Me A Wish!**  
- **Want custom writing/design?** Order directly from a local bakery or grocery bakery rather than relying on a delivery app.

If you tell me the **city/ZIP code**, **delivery date**, and whether you want **custom writing**, I can narrow it down to the best specific places.
